name: cyanheads-mcp-server
description: Fleet discovery for the cyanheads MCP ecosystem — semantic search + install snippets.

catalog_url.title: Catalog URL
catalog_url.description: Remote fleet.json endpoint (schema v2 with baked embeddings). Defaults to the canonical cyanheads fleet — override to point at your own hosted catalog.

similarity_floor.title: Similarity Floor
similarity_floor.description: Cosine similarity cutoff for cyanheads_search results (0-1). Raise to require closer matches; lower to surface more candidates.
